title: Physical AI moves closer to factory floors as companies test humanoid robots
summary: British tech company Humanoid has partnered with German industrial supplier Schaeffler to deploy an estimated 1,000-2,000 humanoid robots across Schaeffler's global manufacturing sites by 2032, marking a significant step toward integrating physical AI in factory environments.
problem_solved: Addresses labor shortages and operational efficiency challenges in global manufacturing by deploying humanoid robots for factory automation.
why_valuable: Represents a major commercial deployment of humanoid robotics at scale in industrial settings, demonstrating real-world viability of Physical AI technology in manufacturing.
